preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 10**3 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of blocks N is between 2 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= N for K in Ks)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of jumps K is between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N for S, N in zip(Ss, Ns))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the binary string S is equal to N.

preconditions.expression: all(S[i] in '01' for S in Ss for i in range(len(S)))
preconditions.description: Each character in the binary string S is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (1 <= output[i] <= Ns[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 or a valid block number between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (output[i] == max(jumps) for jumps in possible_jumps) for i, (N, K, S) in enumerate(zip(Ns, Ks, Ss)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the farthest block Chef can reach with exactly K jumps, or -1 if it's not possible.
